findings.title: Null updateStrategy cases do not enable rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In createInitialDeployment(UpdateStrategy), the early return for updateStrategy == null happens before the ROLLING_UPDATES feature is added to the Keycloak CR. The parameterized tests testImageChange and testCacheMaxCount therefore run with updateStrategy=null and the preview feature disabled. Since this PR introduces a feature gate for rolling-updates, these cases either will fail once enforcement is in place, or they are not exercising the feature-gated path and give false confidence. The null/default strategy path should also enable the feature or explicitly document/test that the feature is not required for that path.

findings.title: Feature-disabled coverage only for metadata subcommand and not checking exit code
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled launches only the metadata subcommand and asserts the error message, but does not assert exit code 4 and does not cover UpdateCompatibilityCheck. Both UpdateCompatibilityMetadata and UpdateCompatibilityCheck have duplicated feature-gate logic that exits with CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED; a regression in the check subcommand or in the exit code contract would not be caught.
